name: iFlight Nazgul Evoque F5 V3 class, 6S
notes: Class preset of the 5-inch freestyle quad most often recommended ready to fly (docs/research/drones-v08.md). Weights, geometry, motors, props and battery from iFlight's listing; thrust, inertia, motor lag and aerodynamics are estimates. Nothing here is endorsed by iFlight.

wheelbase_mm.note: True X geometry; 236 mm in the default DeadCat geometry (the model is a symmetric X)

dry_mass_g.note: with props, DJI O4 Pro air unit and ELRS receiver

battery.note: the pack of iFlight's take-off weight and hover time

auw_g.note: take-off weight with the 1480 mAh pack, no action camera

twr.note: a 2207 of 1750-1850KV pulls about 1.7-1.9 kg per motor on a 5-inch prop at 24 V on a stand (iFlight's prop tables, miniquadtestbench); x4 / 736 g = 9.5 static, about 8 under a loaded 6S pack in flight

inertia_roll_pitch_kgm2.note: sum of parts: motors and props at the arm ends, arms, plates, air unit, battery on top

motor_tau_ms.note: J / (Kt^2/R + 2 Q0/w0) for a 2207 1750KV with a 3.9 g prop: about 15-20 ms

motor_kappa_m.note: reaction torque / thrust of a 5.1x3.5 tri-blade (Cq/Ct about 0.09 x diameter)

rpm_loaded_fraction.note: loaded rpm / (KV * V), only used for battery current

cda_horizontal_cm2.note: side-on frame, air unit and pack

cda_vertical_cm2.note: set so the top speed in the simulator is about 150 km/h (iFlight states 190 km/h); stands in for the props unloading at speed, which the model does not have

collider_duct_radius_mm.note: open props: one sphere per prop zone

collider_duct_offset_mm.note: reaches the prop tips (arm 84.5 mm + prop radius 65 mm)

v_crash_ms.note: a 5-inch freestyle frame shrugs off more than a whoop

pack_resistance_per_cell_ohm.note: 6S 1480 mAh freestyle pack, wiring and XT60 included

flight_time.value: 12-13 min hover (iFlight); about 4-6 min of freestyle

camera_uptilt_deg.note: the mount adjusts 10-45 deg; freestyle pilots fly about 25-35

camera_fov_deg.note: horizontal field of view of the simulated camera

rates.note: Betaflight 4.5 defaults; freestyle pilots usually fly their own (paste your diff all)

pid_roll.note: P, I, D, F; Betaflight's default tune is made on 5-inch quads

rotor_drag_per_s.note: momentum theory sqrt(g rho A_rotors / m) = 0.93 1/s times 0.55, the share Faessler et al. 2018 measured on an open-prop quad of the same size (0.24-0.54 1/s)

rotor_inertia_kgm2.note: 3.9 g prop (about 0.2 m R^2) + 2207 bell (about 14 g at 11 mm)

wake_loss.note: share of thrust lost at the worst point of a descent through the rotors' own wake (vortex-ring band of momentum theory); sim-core wake.ts

wake_shake.note: turbulent roll/pitch torque in the wake, as a share of one rotor's thrust times the arm (rotor thrust fluctuates by tens of per cent in the vortex-ring state)
